price_basis: Unadjusted exchange quotes; ex-close total-return reinvestment and share consolidation applied explicitly.
cash_unit: CNY per one pre-event share; announcement amounts per ten shares divided by ten.
history_scope_note: 2019 supplies more than the required 119 pre-2020 sessions. Normalization at the first 2019 close leaves all study returns unchanged. Requests before the audited warmup cannot silently use unaudited events.

510050.SH.evidence: Issuer historical distribution table supplies complete record dates, per-share amounts and payment dates for 2019-2025. Exchange option adjustment notices verify the 2019, 2021 and 2022 ex-dates; issuer distribution notices hosted by the exchange verify 2020, 2023 and 2024; issuer 2025 notice verifies record/ex/payment dates and CNY 0.08 per share. No share split or consolidation in the audited period.

512100.SH.evidence: Issuer historical records show a single ex-date distribution in the audited interval: record 2025-01-14, ex 2025-01-15, pay 2025-01-20, CNY 0.037 per share. The distribution attributed to the 2025 fiscal year has ex-date in January 2026 and is excluded. Issuer consolidation notice verifies record 2022-09-01, legal consolidation date 2022-09-02, new-to-old share ratio 0.36555, and suspension/resumption arrangements. Raw September 2 bars have zero volume and stale pre-consolidation prices; September 5 is the first new-unit quote. The known suspension is removed from BOTH calendars before applying the quote-boundary adjustment.

modeling_assumptions: Fractional units retained; ignore account-level rounding up on consolidation.
Cash reinvested at the ex-date close, ignoring actual payment delay; this is a statistical total-return index, not a trading account.

Unknown calendar mismatches, incomplete intraday bars, and unknown zero-volume sessions fail validation. Common missing dates in both vendor files cannot be detected without an independent exchange calendar.
